teacher_info.intro: Ladies and gentlemen! My dears! Welcome to Demi's world, the place that shines brightly on the artistic horizon. My dears, there is a place for everyone who is eager to improve their linguistic ability through a theatrical approach or simply keep improving their communicative skills. I am 32 at the moment and my major interests are Language, Myth, and Culture. I am a whole-soul admirer of theater, cinematography, literature, poetry, and fine arts. The main thing for me is questioning and that's where we start from. I have never stopped examining my experiences and sharing with them since it's an important part of language acquisition. I dwell on the small space between tragedy and comedy.
teacher_info.short_signature: Just a gentleman who by means of theater creates a space for you to learn and practice a language
teacher_info.introduction: Ahoy hoy! If you are reading this, it means that something drew you attention. I am very glad to know that. I come from that what is called philosophical background, which is very unclear to some extent. And some philosophical observations led me to the phenomena of language. It was the time when I started to be interested in different languages. In this case, I would say that linguistics and philosophy are neighbours. The most important thing in case of learning a foreign language is a reflection upon it, consequently it becomes not a simple learning, but a discovery, first of all discovery of yourself. I have to say that I have been teaching English for 2,5 years so far and I have been learning other languages at the same time. I finally found that what I appreciate and totally adore. I have been in those uncomfortable but dynamic situations ( I mean the struggle inside the language) so many times and now I can understand the mechanisms of it. It made my progress faster and more interesting, since I found what works for me. I want you to find the same for you, dear reader.  So here and now I would like to invite you into the wonderland of language and march with me through different obstacles and vicissitudes that the language brings us daily. Dear boys and girls! I'd be delighted to work with you and spend quality time together. At the moment I can work with three language and it seems already as an achievement for me, but there are new horizons that are waiting for us. I would like to offer you my helping hand in case of previously mentioned languages. And the main thing that I work on is actual speaking of the language, so I create those magical conditions for you to feel the freedom of speaking with the variety of methods. Ad fontes! I look forward to hearing from you Cordially yours, Demi

pro_course_detail.title: 🤯 Surzhyk Practice / Практика суржику
pro_course_detail.description:
🙋🏻 So you have been learning Ukrainian diligently for weeks, months, perhaps years. You've finally booked your first ticket to Ukraine, come to this beautiful country, started talking to some folks and as soon as they opened their mouths you were like: "Wait... WHAT?! Is that even Ukrainian? I don't have these words in my notes. What do I do? HELP!" So most likely you have finally bumped into... суржик. 

🤔 What is суржик? 

Суржик is a Ukrainian–Russian pidgin used in certain regions of Ukraine. Since russia has been trying to destroy Ukraine and its culture and language for many decades and centuries, some people started forgetting real Ukrainian words and used Russian words but with a Ukrainian pronunciation. It is considered a "marred" language and it is highly advised to get rid of суржик, however many people still use it which can confuse learners of Ukrainian to a great extent 😵‍💫. 

🙋🏻‍♀️ Why take this class and for whom is it?

✔️ You are planning a trip to Ukraine.
✔️ You want to understand locals better. 
✔️ You are up for the greatest challenge in your life—unveiling the mystery of суржик. 
❌ You are just getting started.
❌ You want to learn standard Ukrainian without any dialects.

course_info.trial_description:
During the trial lesson we will get to know each other and set the foundation for your learning journey. In this session, we’ll discuss your goals, interests, and reasons for learning English. We’ll also determine your current language level through engaging conversations and tailored activities. This will help me identify your strengths and areas for improvement. 

Based on the insights gathered, I’ll create a customized learning plan specifically designed to suit your level and needs. 

Whether you’re focusing on grammar, speaking, writing, or all-round improvement, the trial lesson ensures your learning path is both effective and enjoyable. This session sets the stage for building confidence, achieving your goals, and making your English learning experience truly personalized.

pro_course_detail.title: General English (based on a texbook)
pro_course_detail.description:
These lesson plans are based on the textbooks, offering engaging, structured, and practical activities tailored to each CEFR level from A1 to C2. 

Each plan focuses on improving your core language skills — speaking, listening, reading, and writing — while reinforcing grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation in real-life contexts. 

Lessons include interactive exercises, pair work, and multimedia resources to enhance your participation and retention.

I will give you a short homework to help you learn faster and more effectively.

pro_course_detail.title: Grammar Focus
pro_course_detail.description:
These lessons are focused on mastering grammar through a deep, analytical approach tailored for learners from B1 to C2 levels. 

Each lesson integrates theory, practice, and application to enhance grammatical accuracy and fluency in both spoken and written communication.

These lessons include the correct and appropriate uses of different tenses, prepositions, conjunctions, pronouns, modal verbs, phrasal verbs, and more!

pro_course_detail.title: Conversation Practice
pro_course_detail.description:
These lessons are designed to enhance speaking skills through targeted practice, interactive activities, and real-life scenarios for learners from A2 to C2 levels. 

It will give you the opportunity to practice your speaking skills whilst talking about any topic you would like. During the lesson, I will correct any grammatical mistakes, help you express yourself more naturally, help you build your range of vocabulary, and most importantly help you build your confidence.
